feature.title: Fix overly permissive Firebase RTDB security rules

tasks.title: Add ownership validation to bookings write rule
tasks.description: Current rule `"bookings": { "$bid": { ".write": "auth != null" } }` allows ANY authenticated user to create/modify ANY booking. Fix: add ownership check requiring write to match hostId. Additionally add invitee write for booking creation by non-host users.
acceptanceCriteria: New booking creation allowed for auth.uid matching hostId
Booking status update (cancel) allowed for hostId or inviteeId
validate rule extended: newData.child('hostId').val() === auth.uid for new records

tasks.title: Add ownership validation to routing_forms and routing_pools write rules
tasks.description: Current rules allow ANY authenticated user to write to routing_forms/$fid and routing_pools/$pid. Add ownership checks: forms should validate against hostId/uid field, pools should validate against hostId/uid field.
acceptanceCriteria: routing_counters.$pid.write requires `auth.uid === data.child('uid').val()` (only pool owner increments counter)

tasks.title: Tighten availability slot write rule
tasks.description: Current rule allows any authenticated user to mark a free slot as busy if they write `{status:'busy'}`. This should only be possible via the Cloud Function (which uses admin SDK, bypassing rules). The client-side rule should restrict writes to the slot owner (host). The Cloud Function handles slot booking via admin SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: Cloud Function book-slot.js uses admin SDK — unaffected by this rule change

tasks.title: Add validate rules for formData, webhook_failures, and audit_logs
tasks.description: Add .validate constraints to prevent arbitrary data injection: bookings formData max size, webhook_failures URL format, audit_logs required fields. Add rate-limiting write rules for notifications node.
acceptanceCriteria: bookings.$bid.validate: formData child values are strings, max 500 chars each
webhook_failures.$sid.validate: url is string matching https?:// pattern
